After that, the user needs to choose between several options for the best eye, verbal, and motor response. "Glasgow Coma Scale: GCS Score, Consciousness Level" will then show the result and conclusion of the possible traumatic head injury severity. There are three conclusions, namely minor, moderate, and severe head injury.
